about: Statewide questions that MEDSL's precinct files put with local offices (its local dataverse), once per county or once for the whole state, each found on the state's own list of that year's statewide measures (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 13:54: 'from the state's own list of that year's statewide measures where it answers, so they are marked stated'). pipeline/local_medsl.py joins each one's lines into one statewide question (join_statewide). 'offices_as_filed' are MEDSL's offices joined; 'list' is the state's page read, its 'cache_file' under the cache (not committed); 'quote' is the list's own words for the question, 'mark' how the match to our title was read; 'statewide' the words that make the list a statewide one; 'type' and 'proposer' in this repository's words (pipeline/measures.py), read from the list ('type_as_listed', 'type_quote'); 'state_total', where a state page read prints the question's statewide yes and no, those figures and their words, set against MEDSL's sum in each record (listed_statewide.state_total). Read by D3's readers; every quote checked word for word against its saved file (whitespace and quote marks normalized).
